description: This file defines the SearchIndex class used in the typeahead.js library for client-side search indexing, including methods for adding data, searching, and serialization.

classes.name: SearchIndex
classes.description: A class for creating and managing a search index for typeahead suggestions.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the search index with existing data and trie structure.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds data items to the search index, tokenizing and inserting them into the trie.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data items by their IDs.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search query over the index, returning matching data items.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all data items in the index.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the index, clearing all data and trie structure.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the index data and trie for storage or transfer.
